subject: Tactical wrap-up: exec asks and clarifications for QBR prep
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Tactical wrap-up: exec asks and clarifications for QBR prep

Team —

Thanks for the sync today. Quick recap and a focused list of outstanding asks we need closed before Friday's QBR dry run: 

1) Exec prioritization: Aditya asked for a clear yes/no on whether we can commit the latency SLO improvement to the Hosted tier (P0) for Acme demo. Markus to confirm perf impact + risk.

2) Pricing sensitivity: We need a short note on expected unit-cost delta if we enable continuous batching for the Acme workload (demo vs production). Markus + Marissa.

3) Legal/procurement path: Lauren to confirm what procurement materials we can hand to Acme this week (NDA / SOW templates / SOC2 evidence).

4) Action tracker: please update the attached tracker row with owner/ETA. I attached a CSV with current asks.

Attachments: qbr-ask-tracker-20270804.csv

Deliverable by EOD Thu so we can fold into the deck. If any blocker needs an exec escalation, flag it in the tracker and cc Aditya.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical wrap-up: exec asks and clarifications for QBR prep

Irene —

Quick update on (1) and (2). I ran a perf sweep over the last 5 days and attached a short spreadsheet with deltas. High level:
- Enabling the latency SLO change (reduce 95p by ~25ms) on Hosted P0 is feasible for short sequences but will increase GPU utilization by ~6-9% at current batch sizes.
- Continuous batching for Acme's demo profile reduces token cost by ~11% but adds 8-12ms median latency in steady-state; tail latency impact depends on request burst model.

Attachments: latency-sla-deltas.xlsx, pricing-impact-v2.pdf

I marked a risk flag in the tracker: if Acme sends large burst tests (seq len > 2k), we should route demo traffic to Dedicated to preserve tail latency. Owner: markus_klein; ETA: Thu EOD.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical wrap-up: exec asks and clarifications for QBR prep

Looping in the procurement lens. We can share a redacted SOC2 summary and the standard SOW template this week; procurement will need the following to accelerate:
- Primary contact at Acme (name + email) — ideally procurement contact and technical contact.
- Expected contract term (12/24/36 months) and committed throughput tier (estimate).

I've added a link to the working QBR deck and the draft SOW in the drive; please add one-line bullets for product tradeoffs so legal can pre-clear.

Related links: https://drive.redwood/example/qbr-deck-aug2027

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical wrap-up: exec asks and clarifications for QBR prep

Thanks for the updates. Decision guidance:
- Prioritize demo reliability. If routing the Acme demo to Dedicated avoids a potential escalation during the QBR, do it. We can backfill Hosted enhancements post-QBR.
- Approve the provisional price adjustment if continuous batching yields the 11% unit-cost reduction — save that as an upsell argument for the QBR.

Lauren: please start procurement outreach to Acme procurement (Jamie Collins). CC: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>. Ask them for the technical contact and confirmation on contract term.

Marissa: please consolidate the pricing delta and expected NRR impact as a one-pager for the deck (pull numbers from pricing-impact-v2.pdf).

If legal needs me to sign-off on an exec exception, loop me in.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Product Officer
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical wrap-up: exec asks and clarifications for QBR prep

Thanks — consolidating final action list below (updating tracker row attached). Please treat these as the canonical asks for the QBR deck.

1) Markus: confirm demo routing plan + note fallback to Dedicated in the deck. ETA: Thu 2027-08-05 17:00 PDT. Attachment: latency-sla-deltas.xlsx
2) Marissa: one-pager with pricing delta and NRR impact. ETA: Thu 2027-08-05 15:00 PDT. Attachment: pricing-impact-v2.pdf
3) Lauren: procurement outreach to Jamie Collins and Acme procurement; share SOC2 summary and SOW template; confirm technical contact. ETA: Thu 2027-08-05 12:00 PDT. Related link: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/DEAL-2349
4) Aditya: available for legal/exec exceptions if needed; flag any sign-off calls.

I've attached the updated tracker (qbr-ask-tracker-20270804.csv) with owners and ETAs. If you need to escalate to sales leadership, reply-all to this thread and mark the row as 'escalate'.

Attachments: qbr-ask-tracker-20270804.csv

CC: Jamie — thanks for your time today. We expect a short follow-up from procurement; Lauren will reach out with the SOW and SOC2 summary. If there are specific technical constraints for the demo, please share them by EOD Thu.

Best —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
